about:
Stratas Foods is headquartered in Cordova, Tennessee. The company was founded in October 2008 as a 50/50 joint venture between ACH Food Companies and Archer Daniels Midland (ADM). ACH contributed a portfolio of brands including Frymax, Mazola ZT, and Sweetex, along with a retail bottled oils group, while ADM brought a vast North American production network with global procurement, processing, and transportation resources.

Stratas Foods operates across three segments: Foodservice, Food Ingredients, and Retail. It manufactures a range of products including bakery fats, butter-flavored oils, dressings, frying oils, margarine, mayonnaise, mustard, olive oils, pan sprays, salad oils, vinegar, and cooking wines. The company also provides custom products and private label solutions for chain and distributor customers. Production facilities are located in Decatur, IL; Englewood, NJ; Fresno, CA; Memphis, TN; Nashville, TN; Quincy, IL; Valdosta, GA; and Dallas/Houston, TX, among others.

The company serves the Foodservice, Food Ingredients, and Retail Private Label markets in North America. Customers include restaurant chains, food manufacturers, and retail distributors seeking private label oils, sauces, and dressings.

Stratas Foods was formed to combine ACH's brand portfolio with ADM's production and supply chain infrastructure, positioning the joint venture as a leader in the North American fats, oils, mayonnaise, dressings, and sauces market.
